description: Operate artbyjazi/autoclip, the MIT-licensed local-first AI video clipper that turns long-form video into ranked, caption-burned, speaker-tracked 9:16 vertical clips. Run autoclip doctor to check ffmpeg-full (libass/libx264) and Python 3.11/3.12 dependencies, run autoclip clip <url|file> for end-to-end ingestion, Whisper transcription, LLM highlight detection (local Ollama or BYOK Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini), MediaPipe face/speaker-tracked vertical reframing, animated caption styling (bold_pop, karaoke_fill, clean_lower, boxed), and multi-aspect export (9:16, 1:1, 16:9), or serve the local review web app (autoclip serve). Use when the user wants to convert long videos, podcasts, or webinars into vertical Shorts, Reels, or TikTok clips without uploading video to third-party servers. Triggers on: autoclip, auto clip, AI video clipper, podcast clipper, long to short video, vertical reframing, speaker tracking video, burn animated captions, youtube to shorts clipper.
